title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting UPDATE is still the unguarded update_reference_call_status — the taken_over_at backstop SQL exists but is never wired into the handler, and the race pin calls the guarded SQL directly (vacuous)
evidence:
form_handler.gleam:1235-1256:
      case row.taken_over_at != "" {
        True -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token)
        False ->
          // RC4.3 (AD-7): a row that already ran its one correction cycle
          ...
          case row.correction_cycles >= 1 {
            True -> exhaust_wrong_person(config, row, id_uuid, token)
            False ->
              case
                sql.update_reference_call_status(
                  config.db,
                  id_uuid,
                  sql.AwaitingCorrection,
                  "",
                  "contact_invalid",
                  sql.ContactInitiated,
                )
update_reference_call_status.sql:23-24 (executed writer — no backstop):
WHERE id = $1
  AND status = $5::reference_call_status
mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql:14-16 (the backstop — zero production call sites; only the Squirrel wrapper + the test):
WHERE id = $1
  AND status = 'contact_initiated'::reference_call_status
  AND taken_over_at IS NULL
take_over_reference_call.sql:20-26 (status stays contact_initiated, so the status-only guard still matches):
SET taken_over_at = now(),
...
  AND status IN ('queued', 'contact_initiated', 'unreachable')
reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:1740-1747 (vacuous pin — drives the SQL, never the POST route):
  // Take-over lands between the wrong-person read and the UPDATE.
  actions_handler.do_take_over(config, app, landlord, call).status
  |> should.equal(200)

  // The dedicated guarded UPDATE 0-rows — the row is never yanked.
  let assert Ok(returned) =
    rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)
  list.length(returned.rows) |> should.equal(0)
correct_reference_call.sql:43-45 (no taken_over_at guard — the yanked row can be corrected into a dead letter):
WHERE id = $1
  AND application_id = $2
  AND status = 'awaiting_correction'::reference_call_status
sweep_due_reference_calls.sql: taken_over_at IS NULL (A7) — the re-queued row is never swept.
detail: Handler still executes unguarded update_reference_call_status for the awaiting transition; the backstop SQL has no production call site and the race test drives it directly. A take-over racing the POST yanks the row; correction re-queues it into a sweep-excluded dead letter.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person's awaiting arm; rewrite wrong_person_awaiting_sql_has_taken_over_backstop_test to POST the real /reference/:token/wrong-person route; add a taken_over_at guard to correct_reference_call.sql.
